title: New reactive groups expose their first value or its selector error
summary: The delayed one-item Observable group already delivered 7 on the parent. The Flowable challenge distinguished the revisions: the merge exposed the new group and delivered the selector error to both observers.

change.description: Observable.groupBy now queues a first item before an unclaimed group can finish. The Flowable change also exposes a newly created group when selection of that item’s value fails.

notes: The key is known before the value conversion. Independent inner and outer subscribers check where the selector’s failure becomes observable.

With identical compiled caller bytes, 3.0.0-RC3 matched the parent and 3.0.0-RC4, 3.0.0-RC5 matched the landing on all three histories. A synchronous outer observer changed a value used by the selector. The parent and RC3 selected the changed value. The landing, RC4 and RC5 selected the initial value before publishing the group.
